title: Only 15% Of Adults Can Pass This Dentist Entrance Exam
summary: Ten questions move from familiar teeth to the anatomy and science future dentists study.

landing.intro: The first few questions seem simple. Then the exam moves beneath the enamel and into real dental anatomy.

about.body:
This ten-question entertainment challenge moves from basic dentition into tooth anatomy, oral disease and head-and-neck science. The questions become more technical as the exam progresses, ending with knowledge commonly encountered in dental education.

Choose one answer for each question. Correctness stays hidden until the final reveal, where the complete review explains how your dental knowledge held up.

The factual content was checked against educational information from the American Dental Association, the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, and the US National Library of Medicine.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Answer ten increasingly difficult dental questions.
Choose one of four answers without outside help.
Reveal your score, then unlock every answer you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This is not a real dental-school entrance examination, professional qualification or source of personal dental advice.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your ten answers have been checked and your dental knowledge score is ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: The Dental School Standout
profile-1.copy: You handled everything from tooth counts to cranial nerves with exceptional precision. Very little in this entrance-style challenge could catch you out.

profile-2.title: The Future Dentist
profile-2.copy: You passed a challenge that most adults cannot. Your grasp of dental structures, disease processes and head-and-neck anatomy is impressively strong.

profile-3.title: The Dental Knowledge Pro
profile-3.copy: You know far more than the basics of brushing and fillings. A few specialist anatomy questions separated your solid result from the pass mark.

profile-4.title: The Confident Patient
profile-4.copy: The everyday questions clicked, while the material beneath the enamel proved more demanding. The complete review will connect every missing detail.

profile-5.title: The Waiting-Room Rookie
profile-5.copy: This exam quickly moved into specialist territory. Your strongest category still reveals which part of dental science already makes sense to you.
